entries:
Alpha 1.79.59 (Your look, your next chapter)

  • Weapon Garment, Armor Garment and Offhand Garment now sit in one centered row directly below your character picture. Each slot shows your current appearance or Original gear and opens the matching Wardrobe selector.
  • Choosing a garment slot opens your collected looks; applying or resetting remains an explicit action in town. Your real equipment, combat stats and independent weapon/offhand appearances keep their existing rules.
  • The Lore Book now shows your other accepted tasks with objectives and progress, prioritizes the quests you track, and links directly to the right journal entry. Tasks you have not accepted stay out of this overview.
  • After you personally claim the finale, the book clearly marks your Chronicle complete and remembers earlier roads in the past tense. New memories preserve your reading position and keyboard focus.
  • Retains the full garment collection, searchable Veyra catalogue, clearer manual quest acceptance and turn-in, remembered window positions and coordinated service menus. Broader art, usability, performance and release-readiness work continues.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.58 (A wardrobe for every celebration)

  • Seven new complete outfits join Winterthorn Revel: Hollow Court for Halloween, Rosebound Vow for Valentine's, Lantern Envoy for Lunar New Year, Springbloom Jubilee, Solstice Pyre for midsummer, Gilded Harvest and Midnight Masque. Bat wings, heart and dragon crests, flowers, flames, wheat and a pierced masquerade diadem give each look its own modeled details.
  • The requested collection now includes six modeled weapon/offhand families, four class-themed outfits and eight universal outfits. Every complete outfit fits all four classes and replaces all body-gear visuals together. Your actual gear, stats and independent held appearances keep their existing rules.
  • Veyra's collection supports name/theme search and categories for complete outfits, weapons, offhands and individual armor. Catalogue replies retain your scroll position and keyboard focus. Browsing keeps purchases explicit, and another character starts with clean filters.
  • Stash, forge, trading-house and direct-trade windows share the equipment menus' framing. Active tabs are clearer; trade rows and the Gold field are easier to read and use. Offer acknowledgements and confirmation rules are unchanged.
  • Retains the earned Lore Book, current-task and tracking links, clearer manual quest review, remembered window positions and layout reset. Final collection art review and broader world, menu and release-readiness work remain in progress.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.57 (Forged looks and clearer stores)

  • Six permanent held appearances now have distinct 3D models: the Grovekeeper thornblade and oak-relief shield, Skyweaver crescent dagger and bound grimoire, Hearthkeeper phoenix staff and Tidekeeper flanged mace. Existing unlocks gain their models automatically.
  • Nightglass Cowl, Dawn Reliquary and Astral Sovereign bring modeled Rogue, Cleric and Wizard outfits alongside Iron Oath Regalia. Winterthorn Revel adds crimson festival robes, holly seals and an antler crown. Every complete outfit fits every class and replaces all body-gear visuals together.
  • Veyra's preview can inspect a weapon or offhand up close, rotate it and compare it with the equipped look. Your actual gear, combat stats and independent held selections keep their existing rules.
  • Merchant offers show slot icons, individual Gold prices and clear wallet or full-bag feedback. Prices match the existing purchase cost. Character, bag and merchant framing is more consistent; bags show used capacity and Sell All controls are easier to read and tap.
  • Retains the searchable earned Lore Book, clearer manual quest acceptance and turn-in, and remembered window positions with a Settings reset. Seven universal garment designs and broader menu/world polish remain in progress.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.56 (Your armor, your layout)

  • Iron Oath Regalia is the first complete armor garment: a crowned helm, swept shoulder blades and a pale covenant seal, fitted to all four classes. One selection replaces all worn body gear visuals together; your actual equipment and combat stats stay intact.
  • Weapon and offhand appearances remain independent. Removing the complete outfit restores your individual armor looks. Preview and compare the full outfit at Veyra before choosing it, then apply owned looks through the Wardrobe in safe town.
  • Dragged character, bag, merchant and other managed windows remember their positions on this device across closing, reopening and browser reloads. Wide and compact desktop layouts save separately; phone menus keep their responsive layout.
  • Settings includes Reset window positions, in the Screen category on phones. Temporary viewport clamping preserves your saved desktop layout, and preferences remain usable within the session when browser storage is unavailable.
  • Retains the searchable earned Lore Book, current-task links, direct quest tracking and clear manual acceptance/turn-in. The wider garment collection and menu/world polish remain in progress.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.55 (Your Chronicle, remembered)

  • Open the Lore Book inside your quest journal to revisit completed chapters, recovered discoveries, restoration accounts and Ilyra's words. Story so far and What I'm doing now reconnect your memories with your current task.
  • Search your recorded memories by a person, place or phrase, and browse chapters or discoveries. Your selected memory and search stay in place when progress refreshes or you reopen the journal.
  • Tracked quest cards now open the relevant story or contract entry directly with mouse, keyboard or touch. Your tracking choices stay in place.
  • Quest conversations lead with status, objectives, progress and rewards. Authored paragraphs are easier to read, and acceptance or turn-in controls stay reachable through long dialogue on desktop and phone. Pending requests, retry feedback and personal reward acknowledgements remain visible.
  • This remains an open-alpha quest and interface update. Full prior patch history is available through Load more notes; garment models, wider menu polish, world presentation, performance, device playtests and release-readiness work continue.

Alpha 1.79.54 (World surfaces, foliage rendering and remembered windows)

  • Earth trails keep soil and pebbles at a consistent scale through sharp bends, with worn wheel tracks, soft shoulders and the existing Lanternhold paving transition.
  • Water, Fire and Air trails gain realm-colored gravel, worn tracks and physical surface detail that stays consistent around bends.
  • All five dungeon floor families use smaller, more natural stone courses. Thorncrypt floors have worn, shallow joints, and its roots carry bark grain along their curved branches.
  • Ilyra's costume now uses lighter geometry at gameplay distance and restores its original detail for close views. Face, hands, hair, staff and animation retain their supplied appearance.
  • Supported browsers draw the existing foliage in fewer groups while preserving its placement, shape and shadows. Other browsers keep the existing rendering path.
  • Character, inventory and merchant windows keep their dragged positions when closed and reopened during the same game session. Companion layouts respect your placement, and smaller viewports keep windows reachable.
  • This remains an open-alpha world and rendering update. Full prior patch history is available through Load more notes; broader world presentation, gameplay performance, device playtests and release-readiness work continue.

Alpha 1.79.53 (Reliable returning sessions and faster world preparation)

  • Entering the game now chooses phone or desktop controls for the current screen, including resizing during login and iPads that identify as Macs. During play, menus stay consistent with the installed controls.
  • Returning to login clears old touch controls and open game windows. Moving between phone and desktop layouts restores the original settings, navigation, quest and skill controls without duplicated tabs or hidden desktop options. Failed world loading also releases its controls and renderer before retry.
  • Lanternhold ground and court paving build faster. Returning sessions reuse the exact town and Earth ground-map data while keeping each session's textures independent.
  • World appearance, scenery, collision and gameplay remain unchanged. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes; broader world presentation, device, combat-performance and release-readiness work continues.

Alpha 1.79.52 (Clearer party feedback and reduced combat motion)

  • Simultaneous skill and party messages now find separate space above or below one another, retaining source names and readable phone-edge wrapping through portrait and landscape changes.
  • Reduced motion now stops floating text movement and pop animations, decorative class-cast motion, persistent field ornaments, status effects and Spirit Guardians orbiting, wing movement and pulsing. Both the device preference and the in-game setting apply while playing.
  • Spell ranges, warnings, caster following, paid casts, damage, healing and effect expiry stay intact. Reduced motion keeps the feedback visible.
  • Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes. This is an open-alpha accessibility and combat-readability update; final world presentation, device playtests and release-readiness work continue.

Alpha 1.79.51 (Complete class rune choices and combat consistency)

  • All fifty-two learned skills across Fighter, Rogue, Wizard and Cleric now offer three optional rune choices at levels 50, 70 and 90.
  • Wizard precision runes specialize beams, missile volleys, Focus charges and Dragonfire Lance. Pyromancer and control skills gain damage, reach, duration, control and cadence tradeoffs.
  • Fireball's Magma leaves a stationary burning field. Meteor Cluster and Apocalypse, shield reflection and explosions, and immediate missile volleys now behave consistently offline and online.
  • Fighter war cries, damage buffs, charges, Grip and finishers gain area, damage, lifetime and recovery choices. Travelling charges retain their chosen rune, Last Stand can reset Shattering Charge, and Iron Fortress's Thorns and Immovable work offline.
  • Rogue marks, wounds, coatings, smoke and traps gain distinct tradeoffs. Blade Storm can change spread or reach; Phantom Volley can launch a barrage, fire faster, or pierce enemies.
  • Fan of Knives, Piercing Throw and Cloak rune effects work offline, including ricochets, wounds, strict low-health execution and one-use Prepared Ambush. Unlaunched Phantom arrows retire when their owner becomes unavailable; launched arrows finish normally.
  • Cleric healing auras, cleansing waves, blessings, weakness marks and Heaven's Trumpet gain footprint, lifetime and recovery choices. Avenging Seraph can favor longer service, damage or health.
  • Boosted Spirit Guardians apply their slowing pulse and can trade it for damage. Sanctuary, Holy Ground, Divine Light healing and guardian damage training reach their offline effects; standalone Boost captures Sanctuary online too.
  • Long floating skill messages stay within phone screen edges, wrap when needed and adapt after rotation.
  • Existing characters, earned progress, rune identifiers and saved builds are preserved. Human class tuning, world presentation and release-readiness work continue. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.

Alpha 1.79.50 (World stability and town presentation)

  • Fixes an unsafe interaction between periodic elite spawning and multiplayer world updates that could crash the server.
  • Lanternhold homes gain leaded-glass detail, warm pane variation and physical surface response on their existing windows.
  • Character rendering avoids repeated temporary allocations and duplicate skeleton checks while preserving equipment, animation, geometry and shadows.
  • Retains quest pacing improvements, connected town paving, Dark Realm masonry, smooth jumps and steady Well Rested auras.
  • Class specialization and rune redesign, crowded-scene performance and release-readiness work continue. Full prior patch history remains available through Load more notes.
